source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB identity; OOB variant is transport-distinct.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x06 0x42 <channel> by IB and OOB; generic clear-logs pre-step.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command succeeds; response bytes 6-8 Vendor ID equal F2 1B 00 for OEM.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / CHANGED with complete parser and Project-approved OEM reference.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB variant confirms raw semantics but cannot replace IB.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 treats channel/reference as readiness and ED-35 preserves read-only scope.

original_test_intent: Read complete channel information for one approved BMC channel through IB and validate channel identity, capabilities and the applicable OEM vendor identifier.
original_method: Run preserved raw 0x06/0x42, validate completion/length/echo/all fields and compare vendor-ID bytes with the source requirement or approved Project override.
manual_activity: Engineer validates supported channels, field numbering and whether F2 1B 00 applies to the Project once; bounded reads need no confirmation.
agent_execution_scope: Validate vendor ID in its field

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Overly conservative because the request is explicit; exact parser/reference are readiness inputs.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected bounded raw 0x06 0x42 with length/echo/full-field and vendor-ID validation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Raw command, F2 1B 00 requirement and 10/5 timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read the approved channel, decode all standard fields and validate the OEM ID at the documented position against Project applicability.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds full parsing, protected transport and Project reference handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: IB remains required; a matching byte substring alone is insufficient.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong field numbering/channel can falsely identify transport capabilities or OEM.

project_override_considerations: If Project SPEC has a different OEM ID, record source F2 1B 00, approved value and coverage difference; do not silently overwrite Master.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Command and OEM criterion are coherent; full-field parser and Project applicability are execution-readiness/acceptance refinements.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read method is explicit and deterministic after channel/schema/reference inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents a coincidental F2 1B 00 substring from passing and keeps fixed source OEM expectation traceable for multi-project use.
independent_technical_reasoning: The query is read-only and fully scriptable. Correctness requires response-boundary and channel-echo validation before interpreting bytes 6-8, plus Project confirmation that the source OEM ID applies; these do not require per-run human action.
